description: Hand-labeled ground truth for the P-101/V-2201A demo scenario, spanning all 7 curated document types. Used to sanity-check ingestion, entity/relation extraction, retrieval, reasoning, and prediction against known-correct answers — not auto-generated, and not guaranteed to be extracted with 100% recall/precision by the current pipeline (that gap is exactly what docs/benchmarks/ measures).

ground_truth_relations.evidence: V-2201A is P-101's upstream isolation valve (oem_manual_P101.txt Section 7)
incident_report_P101.txt: 'Pump P-101 failed due to Valve V-2201A blockage'

ground_truth_contradiction.conflict: inspection_report_P101.txt (2024-03-10) states V-2201A was OPEN; incident_report_P101.txt (2024-03-22) states V-2201A was found CLOSED at the time of the trip
ground_truth_contradiction.expected_detector_behavior: ContradictionDetector should flag a state conflict on V-2201A across these two documents — see docs/architecture/reasoning.md#5-reasoning

ground_truth_questions.question: What is the failure history of P-101?
What standard governs inspection of P-101?
Is Valve V-2201A currently open or closed?
ground_truth_questions.note: This question should surface the contradiction rather than assert one state confidently.

ground_truth_recommendations.trigger: Bearing wear reported in maintenance_log_P101.txt and inspection_report_P101.txt
ground_truth_recommendations.expected_recommendation: Schedule/expedite drive-end bearing replacement for P-101

ground_truth_recommendations.trigger: Root cause in incident_report_P101.txt: undocumented valve state change by another crew

failure_risk.reasoning: 2 recorded incidents/failure events within ~2 months, vibration above alert threshold twice, is exactly the pattern app/ml/datasets/synthetic.py's failure_prediction label formula weights toward label=1 (high failure_count/incident_count, low inspection_frequency relative to incident rate)

maintenance_priority.reasoning: Recent bearing replacement + documented recurring wear pattern
